Interface UpdateHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseTUIController, ConnectionManager, GameController, LobbyController, LobbyController, NetworkSetupController, PreLobbyController, PreLobbyController, ViewGameController
public interface UpdateHandler
Client-side handler for everything the connection delivers from the server: game updates, errors and connection-lifecycle events. A ServerAdapter pushes these callbacks to the registered handler; the error/disconnect/reconnect methods are defaulted to no-ops so implementations only override what they care about.
